method: each email stripped of addresses, links, numbers and IDs, rewritten by a model in its own words, then grouped by hand into themes; a problem raised by only one person is folded into a broader theme

themes.theme: Pets missing or reset after signing in again
Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it
Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong
Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open
Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet
Requests to delete an account or personal data
Requests for more pets, items or features
